name: PhotoMagic South Indian Pre-Wedding Collection
description: Taxonomy and prompt matrices for generating Tamil and Malayalam pre-wedding shoots across locations, cultures, religions, and outfits.

templates.outfit: Traditional Kasavu Saree & Gold Border Mundu
templates.title: Alleppey Kettuvallam Boathouse Dawn • Traditional Kasavu
templates.caption: Romantic Malayali couple in traditional ivory and gold Kasavu attire drifting on a handcrafted houseboat at sunrise.
templates.prompt: Cinematic pre-wedding photography of a romantic Malayali couple on a luxury traditional Kerala wooden houseboat drifting on the serene Alleppey backwaters at sunrise, woman wearing an elegant ivory and gold Kerala Kasavu saree with subtle gold jewelry, man in matching Kasavu mundu and linen shirt, palm trees reflecting on the water, soft misty morning golden light, fine art portrait.

templates.outfit: Maroon Kanjeevaram Silk & Raw Silk Kurta
templates.title: Regal Chettinad Palace Corridor Walk
templates.caption: Tamil couple in royal silk attire holding hands through ancient Burma teak pillars and Athangudi tiled corridors.
templates.prompt: Regal Indian couple holding hands in traditional silk attire walking gracefully through the ancient Burma teakwood pillared corridors and Athangudi tiled courtyard of a Chettinad palace, warm sunlight filtering through, Vogue editorial aesthetic.

templates.outfit: Blush Peach Gown & Beige Linen Suit
templates.title: Kovalam Golden Sunset Coastal Tide Walk
templates.caption: Romantic couple walking barefoot along the glowing shoreline with gentle turquoise Arabian Sea waves.
templates.prompt: Breathtaking pre-wedding sunset photography on a scenic coastal beach in Kovalam Kerala, Indian couple walking barefoot on wet sands where ocean waves gently lap, woman wearing a long flowing blush peach chiffon gown catching the golden sunset light, man in a tailored light beige linen suit, warm amber sky and glowing horizon, candid romance.

templates.title: Shore Temple Coastal Sunset Silhouettes
templates.caption: Ancient stone shore monolithic carvings against glowing sunset tides and crashing waves.
templates.prompt: Full frame fine art pre-wedding photography of a contemporary South Indian couple standing near the historic monolithic stone temples of Mahabalipuram at sunset, ocean breeze catching woman's flowing drape, cinematic dynamic range, 50mm portrait.

templates.title: Munnar Emerald Tea Estate Mist & Romance
templates.caption: Misty highland tea slopes, warm woolen shawls, and quiet morning dew romance in the Western Ghats.
templates.prompt: Cinematic pre-wedding shoot in misty Munnar highland tea plantations, young Malayali couple wrapped in cozy woolen shawls walking down lush green terraced hills at dawn, soft morning mist and gentle sunrise flare, 85mm lens compression.

templates.title: Pastel French Quarter Colonial Arches
templates.caption: Vibrant yellow arches, bougainvillea blossoms, and vintage French colonial doorways.
templates.prompt: Charming pre-wedding couple photography in White Town Pondicherry, couple laughing beneath vibrant yellow colonial arches with cascading pink bougainvillea flowers, cobblestone street, natural daylight, candid editorial style.

templates.outfit: Mustard Yellow Silk & Traditional Silk Veshti
templates.title: Heritage Madurai Oonjal Garden Swing
templates.caption: Joyful laughter and natural chemistry on the flower-draped teakwood swing in traditional attire.
templates.prompt: Traditional South Indian Oonjal swing ceremony photograph, happy bride in mustard yellow silk saree and groom seated on flower decorated wooden swing, family gently swinging them, laughing candid moment with marigold decor.

templates.outfit: Boho Indo-Western Flowing Dress & Linen Shirt
templates.title: Varkala Cliffside Ocean Horizon Sunset
templates.caption: Standing high on the iconic red laterite cliffs overlooking the endless Arabian Sea at golden sunset.
templates.prompt: Dramatic wide environmental pre-wedding portrait of a couple on Varkala red cliffs in Kerala, sunset over the ocean horizon, crashing waves below, wind blowing bride's dress, cinematic golden tones, 35mm lens.

templates.outfit: Emerald Green Anarkali & Dark Charcoal Blazer
templates.title: Kodaikanal Tall Pine Forest Sunbeam Walk
templates.caption: Walking hand in hand through towering pine trees with morning god rays cutting through mountain mist.
templates.prompt: Cinematic pre-wedding photography of a stylish Tamil Muslim couple walking along a needle-covered trail in Kodaikanal Pine Forest, golden sunbeams piercing through tall straight trees, woman in rich emerald green outfit, man in tailored blazer, quiet intimate pose.

templates.outfit: Royal Sapphire Silk Kurta & Embroidered Lehenga
templates.title: Kumarakom Waterfront Infinity Pool Romance
templates.caption: Candlelit luxury villa patio overlooking calm backwater lagoons during the blue hour.
templates.prompt: Luxury pre-wedding evening photography at a private pool villa in Kumarakom Kerala, elegant couple in royal sapphire and gold evening attire standing by the illuminated infinity pool overlooking lake at blue hour, warm ambient lanterns, reflection on water.

templates.outfit: Contemporary White Linen & Minimalist Pastel Saree
templates.title: ECR Coastal Breeze & Pastel Sunrise
templates.caption: Gentle morning breeze and soft pastel pink dawn skies along the private Coromandel coast.
templates.prompt: Editorial pre-wedding portrait on the private beach coast of Chennai ECR, young modern Tamil couple sharing a laughing candid moment on pristine sand dunes, pastel pink and lilac sunrise sky, natural soft daylight, 50mm portrait.

templates.outfit: Wine Red Flowing Gown & Navy Suit
templates.title: Athirappilly Majestic Waterfall Backdrop
templates.caption: Standing on rocky outcrop with the mighty roaring waterfalls and lush rainforest mist behind.
templates.prompt: Epic fine art pre-wedding photography at Athirappilly Waterfalls in Kerala, couple standing on natural rock plateau with grand cascading waterfall and lush green rainforest in background, woman in dramatic flowing wine red dress, man in sharp navy suit, soft mist in air.
